title: NIST WebBook: Water boiling temperature
summary: The WebBook lists 1 boiling temperature row(s) for Water. Reviewed rows and experimental rows are both quoted.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook boiling temperature rows for Water (CAS 7732-18-5) print: 373.17 ± 0.04 K, method AVG, reference N/A, comment: Average of 7 values; Individual data points (calculated or reviewed row). The page mixes reviewed or averaged rows with rows tied to a named experiment or compilation. A Review or AVG method is an evaluation. A Ccb method is combustion calorimetry, as the WebBook method code is linked. This card does not average the rows into a new number.
